principle: No legally usable, source-identified, fresh and verified data => no numeric prediction or recommendation. Missing data stays missing and must never be fabricated, imputed, silently defaulted, or replaced by stale values.

absolute_invariants.TW_MARKET_SCOPE: Only instruments and rules explicitly supported by the Taiwan model may be analysed. Unsupported security types, special trading states or market-rule exceptions must be blocked rather than forced through the common-stock model.
absolute_invariants.LEGAL_SOURCE_ONLY: Every scored or predictive input must come from a source whose access and intended use are explicitly permitted. A public URL is not by itself a licence. Website scraping, raw redistribution and real-time quote use require separate permission when the source terms require it.
absolute_invariants.NO_IMPUTATION: A missing, failed, stale, mismatched or legally-unusable source remains null/unavailable. Never replace it with zero, a guessed value, another provider's unverified value, the previous period, a synthetic value, or a model estimate pretending to be observed data.
absolute_invariants.FACT_ESTIMATE_SEPARATION: Observed facts and model estimates must be labelled separately. A model output must never be displayed as an observed market fact.
absolute_invariants.TRACEABILITY: Every observed number used in scoring or prediction must be traceable to source, dataset, data date/period and retrieval/verification status.
absolute_invariants.FRESHNESS: Current-state outputs require the latest completed official trading session or the latest required reporting period. Calendar-age tolerance must never turn an older session into 'current' data.
absolute_invariants.PRICE_CROSS_CHECK: Price-based prediction requires same-security, same-session official close cross-check. Any mismatch blocks the prediction.
absolute_invariants.NO_FAKE_CONFIDENCE: Do not display confidence, probability, win probability or success rate unless it is calibrated from a statistically valid out-of-sample test with sample size and method disclosed. Heuristic scores are not probabilities.
absolute_invariants.TAIWAN_MICROSTRUCTURE: All executable prices must obey Taiwan tick size, price-limit/reference-price rules, trading-session rules, and attention/disposition/suspension restrictions applicable to that security.
absolute_invariants.CORPORATE_ACTION_GATE: Ex-right/ex-dividend, capital reduction, split, new listing/no-limit periods or other reference-price discontinuities require explicit adjustment or the price prediction must be blocked.
absolute_invariants.MODEL_VALIDATION_GATE: A horizon whose out-of-sample status is FAIL or INSUFFICIENT must not be presented as a validated recommendation. It may only be shown as an explicitly unvalidated research estimate.
absolute_invariants.FAIL_CLOSED: When a required gate cannot be evaluated, the result is blocked. Unknown is never treated as pass.
absolute_invariants.RAW_REDISTRIBUTION: Raw official datasets may be mirrored or redistributed publicly only when the specific dataset licence/authorisation permits it and attribution obligations are satisfied.
absolute_invariants.AUDITABILITY: The model version, source status, data date and any blocker/warning must be visible or recoverable for every generated result.

open_government_data.licence: 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版 / Open Government Data License v1.0

official_website_only.rule: Do not automate-download or mirror website data unless the provider terms, an open-data listing, or a written agreement explicitly permits it.

real_time_or_delayed_trading_information.rule: Do not ingest or redistribute real-time/delayed trading information without the required exchange/provider agreement.

user_supplied_screenshot.rule: May be used to diagnose discrepancies, but must not silently replace official model inputs.
